instruction: Open the recommended plugin list document and install all the developer tools and productivity extensions mentioned (skip the video conferencing and language tools).

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing developer tools and productivity extensions from document, excluding video conferencing and language tools. Uses custom evaluator with document parsing and positive/negative verification.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly implements both positive verification (required extensions installed) and negative verification (excluded extensions NOT installed), addressing all instruction requirements
Getter dynamically extracts expected extensions from actual document content at /home/user/Desktop/Recommended_plugin_list.docx, not hardcoded values
Metric properly combines positive and negative scores, requiring both checks to pass for full score (lines 122-124 in verify_plugin_installation.py)
Coverage is complete: verifies developer_tools + productivity are installed AND video_conferencing + language_tools are NOT installed
Case-insensitive extension name matching handles variations correctly (line 74 in verify_plugin_installation.py)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Document parsing relies on heuristic keyword detection for categories (parse_plugin_list_docx.py:100-116). Consider adding validation that category headers were actually found, or fall back to alternative parsing strategies if document structure differs
Consider adding fuzzy matching for extension names in case of minor spelling variations between document and installed extension names
Add explicit logging if document categorization yields empty lists, to help debug cases where document structure doesn't match expected format
